tools.name: search_documentaries
tools.description: Search the iWonder catalogue of documentaries. Returns matching films with availability (watch free now on iWonder, or which streaming services carry them) and deep links to the film pages. Pass the viewer’s two-letter country code to scope availability to their region.

tools.name: get_film
tools.description: Full metadata for one documentary on iWonder: synopsis, director, genres, topics, runtime, age rating and a deep link to the film page. Pass the viewer’s country code to also get a one-line availability summary.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: Can the viewer watch this documentary in their country — free on iWonder, with an iWonder Plus subscription, or on which streaming services? Country is required: playability is geo-scoped and fails closed without it.
